name: Disable window minimise/maximise animations
description: Windows snap open and closed instantly instead of animating.
mechanism: Sets MinAnimate="0" under HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop\WindowMetrics ('Animate windows when minimizing and maximizing' in Performance Options).
benefit: Desktop feels more immediate; slightly less compositor work on integrated GPUs.
drawback: Less visual feedback when windows change state.
recommendedFor: Low-end PCs and users who prefer instant UI.
evidence: Documented Performance Options visual effect. Read at sign-in.

name: Disable taskbar animations
benefit: Slightly less GPU/compositor work and a snappier taskbar on low-end hardware.
evidence: Performance Options visual effect. Takes effect after Explorer restarts.

name: Disable transparency effects
description: Turns off acrylic/mica transparency in Start, taskbar and windows.
benefit: Removes blur effects that cost GPU time, most noticeable on integrated graphics.

name: Disable drop shadows for desktop icon labels
description: Removes text shadows under desktop icon labels.
mechanism: Sets ListviewShadow=0 under HKCU\...\Explorer\Advanced ('Use drop shadows for icon labels on the desktop').
benefit: Marginally less rendering work on very low-end systems.
drawback: Icon labels can be harder to read on bright wallpapers.
evidence: Performance Options visual effect. Small effect.

name: Show only an outline while dragging windows
description: Turns off 'Show window contents while dragging'.
benefit: Avoids repainting window contents during drags on slow GPUs/CPUs.
drawback: Only an outline is shown while moving or resizing windows.
evidence: Performance Options visual effect. Read at sign-in.

name: Shorter menu show delay (200 ms)
description: Cascading menus open after 200 ms instead of 400 ms.
benefit: Context and Start submenus feel more responsive.
drawback: Submenus may open when the pointer only passes over them.
recommendedFor: Users who prefer a snappier desktop.
evidence: Documented SPI_SETMENUSHOWDELAY value. Perceived responsiveness only.

name: Disable Widgets (Windows 11)
description: Removes the Widgets board and its background WebView processes.
mechanism: Sets the policy AllowNewsAndInterests=0 under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Dsh.
benefit: Stops Widgets.exe/WebView2 processes (often 100–300 MB RAM) and their background network refreshes.
drawback: Widgets board and taskbar weather button disappear for all users.

name: Disable News and Interests (Windows 10)
description: Removes the taskbar news/weather feed on Windows 10.
mechanism: Sets the policy EnableFeeds=0 under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Feeds.
benefit: Stops the feed's background WebView process and network refreshes.
drawback: Taskbar weather/news is removed for all users.
evidence: Documented Group Policy 'Enable news and interests on the taskbar'.

name: Show file name extensions
description: Explorer shows extensions such as .exe and .pdf.
benefit: Makes disguised files (e.g. 'photo.jpg.exe') obvious — a security improvement.
drawback: Renaming files can accidentally change the extension.

name: Show hidden files and folders
description: Explorer shows items with the Hidden attribute (e.g. AppData).
benefit: Easier access to game config folders in AppData.
drawback: More clutter; easier to delete files that were hidden on purpose.
recommendedFor: Users who edit game config files.
evidence: Standard Folder Options setting. Protected operating system files remain hidden.

name: Open File Explorer to 'This PC'
description: Explorer opens to drives instead of Home/Quick access.
benefit: Faster access to drives; Explorer does not query recent/cloud files on open.
drawback: Recent files are one click further away.

name: Don't show recent and frequent items in Explorer
description: Hides recently used files and frequent folders in Explorer Home/Quick access.
benefit: Privacy; Explorer Home loads faster without querying recent/cloud items.
drawback: Recent files are no longer listed in Explorer.

name: Classic right-click menu (Windows 11)
description: Shows the full Windows 10-style context menu without 'Show more options'.
mechanism: Creates an empty (Default) value under HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-34aa-4e8b-a509-50c905bae2a2}\InprocServer32, which disables the new context menu handler for this user. Rollback deletes the created keys.
benefit: All shell extensions in one menu; fewer clicks.
drawback: Loses the modern menu's styling. Microsoft may change this behaviour in future builds.
evidence: Widely documented per-user COM override; no system files are modified.

name: Align taskbar icons to the left (Windows 11)
description: Moves Start and taskbar icons to the left edge.
mechanism: Sets TaskbarAl=0 under HKCU\...\Explorer\Advanced (Settings › Personalization › Taskbar › Taskbar behaviours).
benefit: Familiar layout; Start is always at the same position.

name: Hide the Task View button
description: Removes the Task View button from the taskbar (Win+Tab still works).
drawback: Task View is only reachable by Win+Tab.

name: Taskbar search: icon only
description: Replaces the taskbar search box with a search icon.
mechanism: Sets SearchboxTaskbarMode=1 under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Search (0 hidden, 1 icon, 2 box).
benefit: Frees taskbar space; the search box no longer renders highlights.

name: Start: hide recommendations for tips and new apps (Windows 11)
description: Stops Start from recommending tips, shortcuts and new apps.
mechanism: Sets Start_IrisRecommendations=0 under HKCU\...\Explorer\Advanced (Settings › Personalization › Start).
